label: Daily Tasks
description: Everyday to-do language for errands, reminders, schedules, and simple planning.

missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Errand planning. 1. 'Мне нужно' is the standard necessity construction. 2. 'Купить хлеб' is a very practical real-life task. 3. This sentence belongs in any everyday survival deck.

Strategic focus: Obligation. 1. 'Я должен' expresses a clear task or responsibility. 2. 'Позвонить маме' gives the line a personal, realistic goal. 3. This is useful for describing plans and reminders.
Strategic focus: Current task. 1. 'Сегодня' anchors the action in the present day. 2. 'Я убираю' is a basic first-person task verb. 3. 'Комнату' makes the chore concrete and easy to visualize.

missions.phrase: после работы я иду в магазин
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Routine schedule. 1. 'После работы' gives a natural time sequence. 2. 'Я иду' is the basic motion verb for walking somewhere. 3. 'В магазин' is one of the most common everyday destinations.

Strategic focus: Planning ahead. 1. 'Я записываю' shows an intentional planning action. 2. 'Дела' is a broad but very useful word for tasks. 3. 'На завтра' makes the sentence about future organization rather than immediate action.
